body.name: Latent-source architecture of \(G\)
body.construction: A witness model \(M_j\) preserves the latent-source architecture of \(G\) when it uses exactly the root vertices \(U\) with precisely the parent incidences specified by \(G\), assigns each \(u\in U\) a finite model-specific latent alphabet of size at most \(H(L)\), and satisfies \(P_{M_j}(U)=\prod_{u\in U}P_{M_j}(u)\). No latent source is merged or added and no cross-source dependence is introduced. The two witness models may assign different marginal masses to the same root vertex; no latent-root law is part of the input.
